verdict_rule: hyp_cells.verdict: design fold fixes the sign; confirm fold decides. CONDITIONAL_POSITIVE = confirm mean > 0, t >= 2, design mean > 0; FAILED_VARIANT = confirm mean <= 0, or t < 2 with MDE <= effect worth having; else CANNOT_DISTINGUISH. SE over date blocks, MDE = 2.8 SE.

cells.title: Rate spike compresses REIT dividend yield spread
cells.refutation: If the REIT basket does not underperform its beta-adjusted expectation and shows no significant negative abnormal return relative to utilities (another rate-sensitive sector) after the yield spike, the hypothesis is refuted.
cells.separation_from_beta: Compare REIT basket return to a duration-matched bond proxy and to the broad market, isolating the rate sensitivity beyond equity beta.
